decisions.reason: A low-cost consumable line with its own product page that fits the core dental lab thermoforming portfolio; its prospects are still uncertain after one year, so the option is worth keeping open.
A PETG blank is a cheap-to-maintain addition to an established thermoforming range with steady lab demand, so keeping it costs little.
It was only mentioned on the website, which signals limited commitment, but a lacquer consumable costs little to keep listed while its uptake in digital printing workflows is still unresolved.
The contrast spray supports the firm's push into intraoral scanning and digital workflows and has its own page, so it is a strategic option worth holding.
Custom earmolds use the firm's existing custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, so carrying cost is low despite the limited web presence.
